title: provider-evidence-index acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.reference.diagnostics; exact inputs: provider_catalog, provider_fixture_digests, interop_report_digests; initial state: pinned provider and protocol catalogs are loaded

stimulus.const: Run identity.reference.diagnostics for success, failure, outage cases using provider_catalog, provider_fixture_digests, interop_report_digests and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: each provider has version, fixture source, checksum, supported modes, latest execution revision, and attributable result; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, outage=unavailable/unavailable; required artifact fields: provider_count, indexed_provider_count, missing_evidence_count, catalog_digest, evidence_index_digest, provider_results

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: each provider has version, fixture source, checksum, supported modes, latest execution revision, and attributable result; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, outage=unavailable/unavailable; required artifact fields: provider_count, indexed_provider_count, missing_evidence_count, catalog_digest, evidence_index_digest, provider_results

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
artifact_hashes must bind the artifact-specific evidence object at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/artifacts/provider-evidence-index.json
artifact_hashes must bind the separately captured coordinator execution receipt at .ai/identity-platform/evidence/executions/provider-evidence-index.json
revalidation_revision is null exactly when tested_revision equals gate_execution_revision; otherwise it equals gate_execution_revision
input_root is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON of input_manifest

invariant.const: each provider has version, fixture source, checksum, supported modes, latest execution revision, and attributable result

initial_state.const: pinned provider and protocol catalogs are loaded
